description: Source code for UpnpDiscoveryManager class handling UPnP device discovery via SSDP on Raspberry Pi 4. Includes context initialization, device discovery, callback handling, and telemetry logging.

classes.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager
classes.description: Manages UPnP device discovery using SSDP, handles context setup, device callbacks, and discovery timeout.

methods.name: ~UpnpDiscoveryManager
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and stopping main loop.

methods.name: initialiseUpnp
methods.description: Initializes GUPNP context and control point for SSDP discovery.

methods.name: discoveryTimeout
methods.description: Handles discovery timeout, stops search, logs 'Unknown' gateway.

methods.name: findGatewayDevice
methods.description: Starts SSDP discovery on specified network interface.

methods.name: on_device_proxy_available
methods.description: Callback invoked when SSDP reply is received, extracts device info, stops search, logs details.

methods.name: enterWait
methods.description: Runs GLib main loop to wait for discovery events.
